title: Stool antigen immunoassays for Campylobacter: diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis (code and data)
description:
Analysis code and extracted data for a systematic review and bivariate meta-analysis of the diagnostic accuracy of stool antigen immunoassays for Campylobacter spp., stratified by platform (lateral flow immunoassay vs microplate enzyme immunoassay) and by reference standard (culture vs PCR). 24 studies, 68 test × reference 2×2 estimates, 13 677 stool specimens.

Protocol registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251160098). Code is MIT licensed; the extracted data are CC BY 4.0.
